D.; severely criticises Appayya Dīkṣita in Rasagaṅgādhara an. Citramīmām3sākhaṇḍana an. Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita in Manoramākucamardana; regarding the popular story of his love episode with a Muslim girl Lavaṅgī in the Moghul [Page138-a. Chaudhuri, Muslim Patronage to Skt. Learning p.. 46-71; also ABORI. Golden Jubilee Vol. p.. 415-20. On his influence on some Deccani a.s of the 17th Cent. see P. K. Gode, J. Myth. Soc.
